name: Olive
use: Customer assistant rebuilt as an agentic AI on Google Gemini Enterprise. It plans meals, builds baskets, finds specials and handles most contact-centre queries.

name: Mandy
use: Virtual assistant for Woolworths' Everyday loyalty, mobile and insurance businesses, such as claiming missing points. It is being upgraded into an agentic 'value companion'.

name: Ulta AI
use: Gemini-powered beauty shopping assistant. It recommends and compares products based on skin type, hair goals and concerns, and helps build routines.

name: Rakuten AI
use: Agentic AI concierge across the Rakuten ecosystem. In the Rakuten Ichiba app it takes budget, purpose and images and recommends products.

name: Sophie
use: Voice and text AI assistant built with NLX and AWS. It handles order status, returns, gift cards, store help and price-match questions.

name: Clementine
use: AI grocery shopping assistant that generates personalized recipes, finds deals and cheaper swaps, and turns photos of shopping lists into carts.

name: Coach by DICK'S
use: Agentic AI adviser built on Adobe Brand Concierge. It gives sport- and level-specific product recommendations, training tips and product education.

name: NikeAI
use: Conversational shopping feature in beta in the Nike App. Shoppers describe what they need in plain language, such as gear for a 5K, and get matching products.

name: Dylan
project: AI Store Concierge, Las Vegas flagship
use: AI 'digital human' concierge on a seven-foot screen in the store. It speaks 100+ languages, recommends products and answers questions on fit and tech.

name: Sage
use: AI virtual assistant for store associates, built with IBM. It handles schedules, time off, pay stubs and policy or training questions.

name: My Woolies Chef
use: AI food assistant that suggests meal ideas and simplifies meal planning. It is in beta for selected loyalty members from September 2026.

name: Penny
use: Gemini-powered grocery assistant that builds baskets through voice, text or photos. It suggests meals and budget-friendly lists using Smart Shopper data.

name: Pixie
use: AI shopping assistant that predicts restocks and builds personalised baskets. Its Smart Chat feature accepts text, voice and images.

name: Next AI
use: AI shopping assistant bar on category pages. It answers open questions and offers prompts like finding a new outfit or getting inspiration.

name: Hello Casto
use: AI-powered virtual DIY adviser that helps customers plan home-improvement projects and choose products.

name: Pocket Coach
use: Conversational AI that trains sales staff by role-playing a virtual customer. It is being piloted in stores.

name: ConsumerIQ
use: Internal AI agent that lets employees query decades of consumer data in natural language. Staff use it to spot trends, build marketing assets and inform R&D.

name: Steijn
use: AI assistant in the Albert Heijn app (formerly My AH Assistant). It answers cooking and product questions, suggests recipes and helps build shopping lists.

name: Team Assist
use: Internal AI support tool that answers employee inquiries. It handles about 7,000 a week and escalates only 1 in 10 to a human.

name: PC Chat
project: PC Health and Shoppers Drug Mart apps
use: AI health chatbot trained on Canadian clinical sources. It answers general health questions and can use linked pharmacy records for more tailored answers.

name: Dustin
use: AI shopping chatbot that gives store locations, hours and discounts. It also points shoppers to coupons and gift promotions.

name: Buddy
use: AI shopping tool that helps customers plan DIY projects, find products and complete purchases.

name: Joy
use: Gemini-powered virtual shopping companion. It handles natural-language and photo search, helps compare products, and links to virtual try-on.

name: Ask Frasers
use: AI shopping assistant built on Algolia. It lets shoppers narrow down products, compare prices and get recommendations in conversational language.

name: ANNA
use: AI beauty advisor chatbot built with Google Cloud. It gives personalized beauty advice, product and routine recommendations, and gift ideas.

name: Grocer genie
use: AI-powered staff app built with Google Cloud. It helps store teams with tasks, restocking, rostering, and analysis of sales and inventory data.

name: uno.ia
use: Internal AI 'super-agent' for executives. It helps with meeting planning, presentations, communications and decision-making.
